map.默认参数：收入 = 5000×20 = 100000 元；直接成本 = 3000: Default parameters: revenue = 5000 x 20 = 100000 CNY; direct costs = 3000+30000+2000+1000 = 36000 CNY; indirect costs = 5000+4000+1000 = ...
map.出塘前核算一个养殖周期的净利润、利润率与投资回报率，评估盈利性。: Before harvest, settle the net profit, margin and return on investment for one production cycle and assess profitability.
map.拆分直接成本（苗、饲料、电、药）与间接成本（人工、塘租、其他），定位成本大头。: Split direct costs (seedlings, feed, electricity, medicine) from indirect costs (labour, pond rent, other) to locate the biggest cost drivers.
map.反算单位成本（元/公斤），与售价比较判断盈亏平衡。: Back-calculate the unit cost (CNY/kg) and compare it with the price to judge the break-even point.
map.产量 5000 kg、单价 20 元/kg、各项成本如默认: Output 5000 kg, unit price 20 CNY/kg, costs as default
map.售价接近单位成本即逼近盈亏平衡，单位成本上升会直接吞噬利润，应优先压降饲料占比: When the selling price approaches the unit cost you are near break-even, and a rising unit cost eats profit directly, so reduce the feed cost share first
map.毛利润和净利润区别？: What's the Difference Between Gross and Net Profit?
map.毛利扣直接生产成本，净利再扣人工/塘租等间接费用，更能反映真实盈利。: Gross profit deducts direct production cost, and net profit then deducts indirect costs such as labour and pond rent, which better reflects true profitability.
